title: Cloud Server Outage Post-Mortems: Past Simple vs Past Perfect
description: Master sequence of events and narrative past tenses during AWS/Azure infrastructure outages, database failovers, and root-cause post-mortems.
learning_objectives: Differentiate Past Simple and Past Perfect in cloud outage post-mortem reports
Apply passive voice to server and container actions
Eliminate Czech past tense collapsing during incident investigations

questions.prompt: During the P1 critical outage review, the cloud engineer realized that the production PostgreSQL database _____ before the automated migration script ran.

explanations.correct: Past Perfect Passive ('hadn't been backed up') is required because the omission occurred before the past action ('realized' / 'ran').
explanations.wrong_A: Past Continuous suggests an action in progress, but a database does not actively back itself up—passive voice is required.
explanations.wrong_C: Present Perfect cannot anchor to completed past events ('realized').
explanations.wrong_D: Auxiliary 'didn't' requires base form 'back up' and is active voice, not passive.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech uses past tense for both actions ('uvědomil si, že databáze nebyla zazálohována'). In English incident reports, prioritize Past Perfect for sequence clarity.

questions.prompt: By the time the DevOps team received the PagerDuty alert, the Kubernetes cluster _____ sixty pods automatically.

explanations.correct: With 'By the time + past simple', the prior completed action takes Past Perfect ('had already restarted').
explanations.wrong_A: Present Perfect cannot be anchored to past event 'received'.
explanations.wrong_D: Present tense cannot describe completed historical cluster events.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech says 'už restartoval' without tense shift; English strictly requires 'had + past participle' after 'by the time'.

questions.prompt: The security operations analyst discovered that the rogue IP address _____ brute-force attempts on the VPN gateway for over three hours before being blocked.

explanations.correct: Past Perfect Continuous ('had been executing') denotes an ongoing past activity leading up to a past cutoff point ('before being blocked').
explanations.wrong_B: Present Perfect cannot connect to past reference 'discovered'.
explanations.wrong_C: Present Continuous describes actions happening right now.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech uses past tense 'prováděla'; English clarifies duration prior to past intervention with Past Perfect Continuous.

questions.prompt: Before the IT administrator rolled back the firmware on the core Cisco switch, he _____ the configuration file to the backup server.

explanations.correct: Past Perfect ('had exported') marks the completed prerequisite before the rollback occurred.
explanations.wrong_A: Present Perfect does not fit the past narrative 'rolled back'.
explanations.wrong_B: Participle alone cannot function as the finite predicate.
explanations.wrong_C: Present Continuous conflicts with past timeframe.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech uses 'než vrátil... vyexportoval'; English technical documentation emphasizes chronological precedence with Past Perfect.

questions.prompt: When the morning shift arrived, the automated Jenkins pipeline _____ all microservice test suites.

explanations.correct: The build was completed prior to the shift arrival at 08:00, requiring Past Perfect ('had already finished').
explanations.wrong_A: Past simple with 'already' is informal and less precise in formal engineering reports.
explanations.wrong_B: Present Perfect clashes with past anchor 'arrived'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech uses perfective aspect 'už dokončila'; in written IT shift handovers, use Past Perfect.

questions.prompt: The storage server crashed because a corrupt log file _____ all available disk space on the primary volume.

explanations.correct: The consumption of disk space happened before the server crashed, so Past Perfect is required.
explanations.wrong_A: Present Perfect clashes with past event 'crashed'.
explanations.wrong_D: Present Simple cannot describe a completed causal event in the past.

questions.cz_learning_point: Root cause reporting in IT incident tickets requires Past Perfect for the root failure condition.

questions.prompt: The change management board rejected the deployment request because the staging environment _____ for load capacity.

explanations.correct: Past Perfect Passive ('had not been tested') correctly expresses the prior omitted validation.
explanations.wrong_A: Active continuous implies the environment was performing the testing, which is impossible.
explanations.wrong_B: Present Perfect does not agree with 'rejected'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'nebylo otestováno' is frequently translated with past simple. In English CAB logs, use Past Perfect Passive.

questions.prompt: Until yesterday's audit, the system architect _____ that third-party cookies were tracking user sessions on the internal portal.

explanations.correct: 'Until yesterday's audit' sets a past limit up to which the lack of awareness existed, requiring Past Perfect.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'až do včerejška si nevšiml' uses simple past. English uses Past Perfect to denote duration up to a past cutoff.

questions.prompt: After the cybersecurity team _____ the compromised API token, the threat actor was unable to access customer records.

explanations.correct: The revoking of the token occurred before the actor attempted further access; Past Perfect is the most accurate sequence marker.
explanations.wrong_A: Present Perfect clashes with past narrative 'was unable'.
explanations.wrong_B: Participle alone cannot serve as predicate.

questions.cz_learning_point: Clauses introduced by 'After' that describe past completed prerequisites take Past Perfect.

questions.prompt: We were relieved to confirm that the Azure failover cluster _____ into operation seamlessly when the primary region went offline.

explanations.correct: The switch into operation preceded our verification in the past; Past Perfect ('had switched') is correct.
explanations.wrong_A: Present continuous is invalid in past context.
explanations.wrong_C: Present Perfect does not fit 'were relieved'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Sequence of tenses following past perception verbs ('confirmed that...') requires Past Perfect in English.
